title: Billie Holiday, Mildred and the maid misunderstanding
summary: Mildred championed Billie Holiday, they hired Billie's mother as a maid, and the mother later gave Billie a wrong account of Mildred.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them
story.community_name: Billie Holiday as the musicians knew her
